capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Wikipedia spec table: Long Range packs 78 kWh gross / 75 kWh usable for 2021-2023 (single) and dual motor 2021-2024; InsideEVs 2024 EPA article confirms 78 kWh for the 2023 single and the 2024 dual/performance pack.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Wikipedia spec table: 75 kWh usable for the 78 kWh Long Range pack (also EV Database Volvo XC40 Recharge 78/75, same CMA pack).

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: NMC for all Polestar 2 packs (EV Database also NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: The 78 kWh Polestar 2 pack is the same CMA 108-cell NMC pack as the Volvo XC40 Recharge 78 kWh (EV Database: 400 V); the Polestar US spec page confirms 400 V for the later 82 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Polestar 2 manual (US, 2023): preconditioning is triggered by adding a rapid charging station as a destination in Google Maps; no manual control listed. The manual says "selecting preconditioning" can affect charging time, so a manual option is not ruled out; the only trigger described is navigation, so automatic_with_navigation is the closest enum.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs (Polestar US 2024 release) states 155 kW for the 2023 Single Motor and the 2024 Dual Motor; the 2023 dual has the same 78 kWh pack and charger. The 2022 US manual says 150 kW; the 2024 manual says 155 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Polestar US 2023 manual: vehicle maximum AC output 11 kW.
